title: What's Really Tea? A Boogie Leaves Fans Confused With Cryptic Post About His Love Life & Baby Plans - NewsBreak
text: Roommates, A Boogie has folks side-eyeing him and asking what’s really tea after he dropped a cryptic message on Instagram recently. The rapper came through with a lil’ update on his relationship status and if he has more kids on the way. Chile, let’s get into it! A Boogie recently shared a message on his Instagram Story and then deleted it real quick, but The Shade Room didn’t miss it. The ‘Look Back At It’ emcee made it clear that he’s single and doesn’t have any babies on the way. “Single and nobody pregnant by me,” A Boogie wrote alongside a laughing emoji. Still, the post had fans confused, while others thought some tea might be brewing. But Boogie has been quiet ever since and hasn’t explained what inspired him to share the update. Folks kept the convo going in The Shade Room’s comment section . Some swore A Boogie was trying to get ahead of some pregnancy allegations, while others think he posted the message just to get his ex-girlfriend and mother of his two kids, Ella Bands attention. See some of their responses below. Instagram user @ mocha.yayaa wrote, “ Welcome to being a responsible adult? ” Instagram user @ therealbadgyal_ wrote, “ But you got 2 kids already??” While Instagram user @ love.driizzy wrote, “ Somebody must have tried to put a baby on him cus whet?” Then Instagram user @ im.popularbaby wrote, “ Ella must’ve finally moved tf on fr this time ! Love that for her !” Another Instagram user @promisepassion_ wrote, “lol he trynna clear it before it comes out ” Instagram user @edenvictoriiaa wrote, “pregnancy allegations coming in 3…2……” While another Instagram user @ _amj___ wrote, “ well since you got so much time now put an album out.” Instagram user @thatshortyoffig2.0 wrote, “translation: if anybody pop out saying it’s my baby in a week they lying.” Finally, Instagram user @unapologetic_goodgirl wrote, “That probably means he got somebody pregnant ” Even with the update on his love life, fans didn’t think much about it as most already knew that A Boogie and Ella have seemingly parted ways a while ago. As The Shade Room previously reported, Ella already gave folks the rundown last year when rumors surfaced of her messing with influencer Marcy Diaz’s ex-boyfriend. Shortly after that Ella made it clear on Snapchat that she wasn’t with Boogie anymore and hadn’t been for months. “But ya know how men are (ya ain’t done until they say ya are) lmao. And it is very hard for him to take me serious when I say I don’t want to be together bc of course I took him back so many times,” Ella explained. However, despite allegedly going their separate ways, Ella called Boogie her best friend and said she would support him no matter where they stood. “I want to see him at his best. I’ve always been that way with him, he’s really my best friend… Even if I can’t stand him sometimes I’m always rooting for him & at the end of the day he is my kids’ father,” she added.
